items.name: changelog
items.description: Update CHANGELOG.md in Keep-a-Changelog style from recent commits, without rewriting history.

items.name: code-review
items.description: Review a diff or branch for bugs, risky changes and missing tests, with findings ranked by severity.

items.name: commit-message
items.description: Write a clear commit message from the staged or working-tree changes (no trailers unless the project asks).

items.name: data-cleaner
items.description: Clean a messy CSV/Excel file: find problems first, fix them reproducibly, keep the original, report what changed.

items.name: docs-writer
items.description: Write or update documentation (README, API docs, how-to) from the code, with examples that were actually run.

items.name: email-drafter
items.description: Draft a clear, appropriately toned email or reply from a few bullet points — short, with a specific ask.

items.name: explain-this-repo
items.description: Explain an unfamiliar codebase: what it does, how it is laid out, how to run it and where to start reading.

items.name: meeting-notes
items.description: Turn raw meeting notes or a transcript into a summary, decisions and an action list with owners and dates.

items.name: refactor-plan
items.description: Plan a safe refactor in small, individually testable steps before touching the code.

items.name: regex-helper
items.description: Build and verify a regular expression against real examples, and explain it in plain words.

items.name: release-notes
items.description: Turn commits or merged changes since the last release into user-facing release notes.

items.name: sql-explainer
items.description: Explain a SQL query step by step, find performance problems, and suggest a safer or faster version.

items.name: test-writer
items.description: Write focused tests for a function, module or bug — matching the project's test framework and style.

items.name: translate
items.description: Translate text or documents accurately, keeping formatting, names and terminology; flag ambiguity instead of guessing.
